info.title: Spendeazy REST API
info.description: The Spendeazy REST API serves financial data in authorized Personal and Shared Spaces through explicit Space-scoped routes. Expenses, Categories, Budgets, Category Rules, and Statement Imports belong to a Space. Expense Added By and Statement Import importer fields preserve actor attribution without changing Space ownership. Bigint identifiers and counts, decimal money, domain dates, and UTC timestamps use the encodings described by the schemas below.

nextCursor.description: Opaque base64url cursor for the next page, or null when there are no more results. A cursor must be reused with the same filters; page size is not part of the cursor.

ExpenseHistoryPageResponseDto.description: A keyset-paginated Expense history page. Results are ordered by expenseDate descending, then Expense ID descending. Active pages omit deleted Expenses; retained-history pages contain only deleted Expenses.

categoryId.description: Required positive bigint Category identifier encoded as a string.

expenseDate.description: Valid calendar Expense date encoded as YYYY-MM-DD.

description.description: Trimmed Expense description at the time of the event.

amount.description: Positive exact two-decimal Expense amount encoded as a string.

ExpenseActivitySnapshotDto.description: The editable Expense values captured before or after an edit.

id.description: Positive bigint activity identifier encoded as a string.

expenseId.description: Positive bigint Expense identifier encoded as a string.

actorUserId.description: Positive bigint identifier of the User who caused the event.

occurredAt.description: UTC timestamp when the activity event occurred.

before.description: Expense values before an edit or deletion. Older Activity records may omit this snapshot.

after.description: Expense values after creation or an edit. Older Activity records may omit this snapshot.

ExpenseActivityResponseDto.description: A recorded activity event for an Expense. Legacy Expenses may have no activity records.

budget.description: Current Budget configuration. Yearly amounts are annual context.

fromDate.description: Inclusive lower Statement confirmation date in Asia/Manila, encoded as a valid calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format. It must be on or before toDate when both filters are supplied.

toDate.description: Inclusive upper Statement confirmation date in Asia/Manila, encoded as a valid calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

pageSize.description: Number of Statement imports to return per page. Must be between 1 and 100 inclusive; defaults to 20. The cursor is not coupled to page size.

cursor.description: Opaque base64url cursor for the next page. Reuse it only with the same date filters; results are ordered by confirmation time descending, then Statement Import ID descending. Page size is not part of the cursor.

spaceId.description: Positive bigint Space identifier encoded as a decimal string.

statementImportId.description: Positive bigint Statement import identifier encoded as a decimal string.

id.description: Positive bigint Statement import identifier encoded as a string.

fileName.description: Statement file name retained after trimming.

statementDate.description: Credit Card statement date; null for E-Wallet imports.

accountFormat.description: Account format retained after trimming, or null when it does not apply.

historyFromDate.description: Inclusive E-Wallet history start date; null for Credit Card imports.

historyToDate.description: Inclusive E-Wallet history end date; null for Credit Card imports.

totalDebit.description: Original non-negative E-Wallet Total Debit control; null for Credit Card imports or legacy imports where this control is unavailable.

importedAt.description: UTC timestamp when the Statement import was committed.

importedByUserId.description: Positive bigint User identifier for the actor who confirmed this Statement Import. It is immutable actor attribution; the Committed Statement Import belongs to its Space.

StatementImportResponseDto.description: A committed Statement Import belonging to the destination Space. The User who confirmed it remains the importer actor. Client file hashes and persistence fields are not returned.

id.description: Positive bigint Statement import identifier encoded as a string.

fileName.description: Statement file name retained after trimming.

statementDate.description: Credit Card statement date; null for E-Wallet imports.

accountFormat.description: Account format retained after trimming, or null when it does not apply.

historyFromDate.description: Inclusive E-Wallet history start date; null for Credit Card imports.

historyToDate.description: Inclusive E-Wallet history end date; null for Credit Card imports.

totalDebit.description: Original non-negative E-Wallet Total Debit control; null for Credit Card imports or legacy imports where this control is unavailable.

importedAt.description: UTC timestamp when the Statement import was committed.

importedByUserId.description: Positive bigint User identifier for the actor who confirmed this Statement Import. It is immutable actor attribution; the Committed Statement Import belongs to its Space.

expenseCount.description: Non-negative current Expense count encoded as a string.

StatementImportHistoryResponseDto.description: A Statement import in the destination Space history collection, including its current Expense count.

items.description: Statement imports ordered by confirmation time (importedAt) descending, then Statement import ID descending.

nextCursor.description: Opaque base64url cursor for the next page, or null when there are no more results. A cursor must be reused with the same date filters; page size is not part of the cursor.

StatementImportHistoryPageResponseDto.description: A keyset-paginated Statement import history page. Items are ordered by confirmation time descending, then Statement import ID descending.

originalExpenseTotal.description: Immutable exact PHP total at confirmation.

code.description: Retained application failure code, including IMPORT_OPERATION_NOT_COMMITTED when recovery fences an orphaned admission.

UnauthenticatedError.description: The request does not include valid Clerk session credentials.

WWW-Authenticate.description: Authentication scheme accepted by the API.

UserNotProvisionedError.description: The verified Clerk identity is not linked to a local User. Provision the User first.

NotFoundError.description: The requested resource is absent or not accessible to the authenticated User.

NotAcceptableError.description: The client did not accept the representation required by the endpoint.

error.message: The endpoint requires an application/json response

InternalError.description: An unexpected server error. Infrastructure details are never returned.

ValidationError.description: The request syntax or fields are invalid.

details.message: Email must be a valid email address

ConflictError.description: The request conflicts with current application state.

ServiceUnavailableError.description: A required external service is temporarily unavailable.

error.message: The identity provider is temporarily unavailable

UnsupportedMediaTypeError.description: A request body must use application/json.

ImportOperationConflict.description: IMPORT_OPERATION_NOT_COMMITTED for fenced recovery rejection; IMPORT_OPERATION_PAYLOAD_CONFLICT for changed frozen content; IMPORT_REVIEW_REQUIRED with error.review for refreshed warnings; Category or Rule conflicts. Identical terminal failures retain their original status/code.

RateLimitError.description: Too many Invite Code attempts were made for the authenticated User or network source.

error.message: Too many Invite Code attempts. Try again later.
